tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: In the manufacture of iron from haematite, limestone is added to act as :

solution.text: Limestone $\left(\mathrm{CaCO}_{3}\right)$ is mixed with $\mathrm{Fe}_{2} \mathrm{O}_{3}$ and it acts as flux to form slag $\left(\mathrm{CaSiO}_{3}\right)$.
